sql: SELECT market_ticker t, side||'/'||action||'/'||status s, limit_price::text p, quantity::text q, coalesce(cancel_reason,'') r, created_at::text at FROM live_orders WHERE strategy='Alimm1' AND (status='resting' OR cancel_reason='series_paused' OR created_at > now()-interval '1 hour') AND coalesce(cancel_reason,'')<>'resting_sell:repriced' AND created_at > now()-interval '5 days' ORDER BY 2,1
